why: Lint cycle 4 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-4.md, lint-4.1 to lint-4.15 P2, lint-4.16 to lint-4.19 P3). The cycle 3 fixes hold and no rule fires on correct code; this cycle's phrasings are caught at 107 of 161, and the misses are the next spellings an agent writes. One miss is structural: alpha-on-premixed is built from the token names (`bg-hover/60`), which are not classes, and misses the classes the theme declares for those tokens (`hover:bg-accent/50`, `border-border/60`), the spelling the shipped primitives use. Three messages give no fix or one another rule rejects: shadcn no-raw-colors' suggestions at bridge (`dark:bg-primary`, `text-dim-bar`), a class spelled from a token name (`bg-hover` gets `Nearest: bg-cover`, `bg-canvas` gets Status), and fixed-colour on a white surface (Button and Status, never Card). Each seed and its line are in docs/v3/cycles/lint-4/fixtures/results.md; reproduce with `zsh docs/v3/cycles/lint-4/fixtures/run.sh $PWD /tmp/lint-cycle-4` after a package build, and the bridge suggestions with `sweep.sh`.
what: The misses of lint-4.1 to lint-4.12 and lint-4.17 caught or stated as known limits, alpha-on-premixed reading the theme's class names, the three messages of lint-4.13 to lint-4.15 naming a fix that passes every other rule, and the P3 messages of lint-4.16 and lint-4.19.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/preset.ts (the shadcn rule options and messages, PREMIXED_ALPHA)
apps/playground/src/scenarios/expr/c10/ReachRings.tsx (the one waiver line of lint-4.18, in its own commit)
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/css/** (the theme's class names are the input, not the change)
change: Misses, each with an invalid fixture block or a stated limit in the rule's JSDoc: viewport-keyed reads an arbitrary `@media` variant on a width feature, an object argument of `useMediaQuery` (`maxWidth`, `minWidth`, `query`), `screen.width` and a window-size hook imported under another name (lint-4.1); `DARK_VARIANT` takes a `/name` group suffix and an element before the attribute in an arbitrary selector, and the stylelint at-rule list takes `variant` with dark-fork's fix (lint-4.2); status-fill-as-text and app-colour-arbitrary take a `color:` type hint inside `(…)` and `[…]` (lint-4.3); template-interpolation reads `${…}-<name>` (lint-4.5); import-boundary adds react-aria-components, @ark-ui, kbar, notistack, markdown-it, react-apexcharts, @mui/x-charts, react-use-websocket, @tanstack/query-sync-storage-persister, tailwind-variants, @tanstack/virtual-core and nuqs to the forms whose defect they repeat (lint-4.6), ui-path reads `src/` and `#/` before `components/ui/`, and use-chat-chat reads `ai/react` and a same-file const options object (lint-4.7); primitive-bypass reads `onClick` on a non-interactive intrinsic element, `<progress>` and `<meter>`, `dayjs(…).format(` and `moment(…).format(`, and a chart kind with no ChartCard or DataPanel ancestor in the file (or `basalt-charts.md` drops the lint tag from that bullet) (lint-4.8); data-primitive reads `.pipeTo(new WritableStream(…))` on a body chain and a conditional with an empty-array branch on a chart (lint-4.9); router-search reads `crypto.randomUUID()` and `getRandomValues()` in a validator (lint-4.10); untrusted-markdown reads `document.write`/`writeln` with a non-literal argument, `allowDangerousHtml: true` in a remark-rehype tuple and `mdx-bundler/client` (lint-4.11); the stylelint preset takes `plugin` in the at-rule list and `orientation` in the media-feature list, and its value list bans the fill-only roles on `color`, a raw length on `width`/`min-width` above the fixed-width threshold and a raw length in `grid-template-columns`, each with its class rule's fix (lint-4.12). Structural: `gen-zone-a.ts` emits the theme class names of the pre-mixed tokens from the `@theme inline` map (`accent`, `selected`, `scrim`, `border`), and alpha-on-premixed and `PREMIXED_ALPHA` read those; the cases test a class the theme declares (lint-4.4). Messages: the bridge no-raw-colors message filters its suggestions through the class forms of the same profile (no `dark:` variant, no fill-only role as text, no chart or sequential colour for a border or surface), and the messages test feeds a raw colour per prefix through the bridge preset (lint-4.13); no-unknown-classes and no-raw-colors map a `--vx-*` token name written as a class to the theme class that reads it and print it (lint-4.14); fixed-colour names the surface (Card, or `bg-card`/`bg-background` at bridge) for a white or black fill (lint-4.15). P3: the token check prefers the same family prefix, folds camelCase and maps shadcn role names (lint-4.16); raw-heading reads `createElement('h2', …)` and colour-literal reads a `color(` string (lint-4.17); svg-data-marks passes an `aria-hidden` mark in a file whose other marks spread `focus.item`, and the c10 waiver goes (lint-4.18); the pre-edit denial for budget.json names `lint --raise <field> --consumer` (lint-4.19). The id ceiling does not move: every change is a form, an option or a message of an existing id.
commits: fix: one commit per rule family in packages/basalt-ui (class, import, structure, stylelint, preset and messages); the ReachRings waiver removal as its own commit.
proof: run.sh from lint cycle 4 reports every seed of lint-4.1 to lint-4.12 and lint-4.17 caught or names its stated limit, every `pass` mark silent, and sweep.sh's ex-bridge output names no `dark:` or fill-only class in a no-raw-colors suggestion.

No shipped message, the bridge no-raw-colors suggestions included, names a class another shipped rule reports at the same profile (test)
